summary:
Repo commit observed: b43a3bdc4a3d — project-memory: add production readiness auto verifier

Add an automatic Project Memory production readiness verifier.

The verifier is triggered by trusted sanitized SG runtime deploy evidence, runs the existing readiness diagnostics runner, and returns ready/not-ready.

It fails closed when deploy/runtime evidence is incomplete and does not require user shell or Telegram commands.

No production readiness claim is made by this change.
